$comment: Computed-style and geometry fingerprints of every catalog variant, settled and on air. Substituting a token for the literal it was given must not move these. Re-record with UPDATE_RENDER_BASELINE=1 only when the look changed ON PURPOSE. Platform-bound: compared only on the platform that recorded it (font rasterization). `recorded` is the day it was taken - the failure message prints it, because the commonest drift is a markup change landed after that day.
